data.strategy_desc:
This is a fully automated, high-yield trading system designed exclusively for the most liquid currency pair — EUR/USD.

Core Features of the Strategy:

Mathematical Approach: The algorithm uses advanced quantitative models to identify precise entry points based on market volatility and price rebounds.

No Emotional Trading: 100% algorithmic execution ensures strict discipline without human errors.

Smart Capital Management: The system is optimized to exploit local price corrections, turning market consolidation into steady profit.  During historical stress-tests (including high-volatility periods of 2025), the algorithm demonstrated exceptional compounding growth potential up to X50 under maximum aggressive settings. However, please note that past performance does not guarantee future results. For CopyFX, we use optimized, balanced settings to prioritize account longevity.
